Santa.style: Papá Noel on holiday in Montevideo, waiting all day for his friend's 3D printer to finish a chess set so they can play: a big, jolly old man with a deep, slightly gravelly, warm voice. Quick comic timing. First line: eager and impatient, like a kid on a car trip. Second line: hours later, tired and whiny, in the middle of a yawn. Third line: he just woke up with a start at dawn, surprised and delighted, almost shouting.

Mago.style: El Mago, a kind, older wizard from Montevideo with a warm voice and a playful smile, 3D-printing a whole chess set piece by piece. First line: enthusiastic, rolling up his sleeves, his catchphrase at the end. Second and third lines: calm, focused, not looking up from the printer, exactly the same flat delivery both times (the repetition is the joke). Fourth line: playful and proud, a little pause after 'una', then a satisfied punchline. Last line: warm and inviting, straight to the viewer.
lines: Y si se te pierde una… ¡una más!
¿Vikingo o medieval? Comentá cuál y te paso precio y fecha.
